_doc: Hook settings for the agent eval, per condition (0.17; tools/agent-hooks). The harness copies
`files` from tools/agent-hooks into its hooks directory, replaces @HOOKS@ with that directory
and @PYTHON@ with its python (e.g. /usr/bin/python3 -I), and merges the condition's `hooks`
into the run's --settings. Environment set in a command: VOLE_CHECK_TESTS=0 leaves the tests
out of the check and turn-end hooks; VOLE_CHECK_HOOK_LOG names the check records' log (the
harness sets it in the agent's environment, as for --check-hook); VOLE_HOOK_STATE the hooks'
Conditions: hook = check after each edit (delta, no tests); hook+test = the same with the
program's tests (tests/NAME.in, NAME.out) after a clean check, debounced, and the turn-end check;
hook+turn-end = the check and the turn-end check without tests; query = the query-first hook
(compiler-tools); turn-end alone = only the Stop hook.
(E3, E5, E6) `modifiers`: what a condition's +MOD adds (lib/conds.py): `env` is set in front of every
hook command of the run (the query-first hook then comes from `conditions.query`), `add` names
more conditions whose hooks the run also registers. +rewrite: query-first runs an unambiguous read
of source as its query instead of blocking it (VOLE_QUERY_MODE=rewrite); +nohints: no hints
(VOLE_HINTS=0: neither repeat-query nor unfamiliar-construct); +note: lookup-note.py, a note
when a guide/query/explain/--help call prints again what it printed earlier (condition `note`).
